12% of remote job listings now require AI skills.

That's 487 of 3,928 active listings analyzed by Loker Dollar. AI now sits behind communication (41%) but ahead of leadership (11%) and sales (9%) in demand.

The roles span far beyond engineering: healthcare SaaS, cloud infrastructure, people operations, sales, and even insurance. The top disclosed pay is USD 132,400-238,400 a year at Jabil for a Sr. Principal Product Engineer.

The catch: only 22% of listings disclose pay, and 78% hide salary entirely. A higher posted figure isn't guaranteed - many high-paying roles stay silent on compensation, so negotiate from market data.

Our take: AI is a differentiator, not a guarantee. Communication still matters in 41% of listings. Add a dedicated AI Skills section to your resume, link a public repo or demo, and mention concrete AI outcomes in your cover letter.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026
